scripts.text:
[ Echoing Voice ]
 ' The one who can overcome an ordeal and show true bravery... will find the way... '
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
“能够克服考验并展现真正勇气的人……将会找到道路……”

scripts.text:
[ Echoing Voice ]
 ' Only the one who can show true bravery can take this test. '
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
“只有能够展现真正勇气的人，才能接受这项测试。”

scripts.text: There's a small lever. Will you pull it?
scripts.translation: 这里有一个小拉杆。你要拉动它吗？
